title: The Choir of Ironhollow
author: Zephyrine Pemberton
blurb: Xanthe Brightwater, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
